This editorial illustration is a magazine cover with a vertical orientation. The top section features a large red masthead reading "TEMPO" in a serif font. Below this, in a smaller black font, is the text "EDISI 4-10 JUNI 2012". At the very top, text in black and white includes "MIRANDA DITERUNGKU, SIAPA MENYUSUL", "LIPUTAN KHUSUS EROPA 2012", and "LIKA-LIKU EKSTASI TENTARA".

The background image is an aerial landscape. A prominent mountain with a pointed peak stands in the distance, partially obscured by a light haze. In the foreground and middle ground, several large multi-story concrete structures are under construction on a hilly, green terrain. These rectangular buildings show exposed concrete frames and some sections with blue or gray roofs. They are scattered across a terraced hillside connected by dirt paths and paved roads. The landscape is predominantly green with patches of brown earth. Large white block text is overlaid across the center of the image, reading "SALDO HAMBALANG DI KAS DEMOKRAT". In the bottom left corner, there is a barcode, a price of "RP 29.700", and a website URL. The overall composition is bordered by a red vertical strip on the left.
